instruction: Identify three seminar photos showing someone in a black shirt presenting with a microphone, and compress them into a zip archive named 'black_shirt_presenter.zip' on the Desktop.

metadata.explanation: Task requires identifying photos showing a person in black shirt presenting with microphone. Analysis: DSC00574 (person in black presenting), DSC00554 (person in black presenting), DSC00495 (person in black presenting) match criteria. DSC00657 has person in black but with another person. DSC00454 shows different person. DSC00659 is audience only. Evaluator lists files in zip and verifies exactly these 3 files are present.
